nodes.title: Test files that swap global state in hooks keep those hooks inside a describe. npm test runs every file in one process, so a top-level beforeEach wraps every other file's tests. Capturing fetch at module load was not enough: the stub was already installed when studio-router.test.mjs loaded (gated deploy of 37247c4 failed the same way). classify.test.mjs and avatar-tutor-routes.test.mjs now scope their hooks in a describe. Reverse if: tests run with process isolation.
